name: desktop-companion
description: Windows desktop companion overlay with a procedural 3D robot and a demo chat window.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test src/shared/foundation.test.mts src/shared/companionLayout.test.mts src/shared/compactAvatar.test.mts src/shared/cursorFollow.test.mts src/shared/cursorFollow.refinement.test.mts src/main/cursorFollow.integration.test.mts src/shared/dockingGeometry.test.mts src/shared/homeGeometry.test.mts src/main/home.integration.test.mts src/shared/screenSelection.test.mts src/main/screenSelection.integration.test.mts src/main/qwenVision.test.mts src/main/offlineVisionSession.test.mts src/shared/clickThrough.test.mts src/shared/robotMotion.test.mts src/shared/behavior.test.mts src/shared/faceExpression.test.mts src/shared/secondaryMotion.test.mts src/shared/rigProbe.test.mts src/shared/chat.test.mts src/shared/chatLayout.test.mts src/shared/qwen.test.mts src/shared/speechAudio.test.mts src/shared/textToSpeech.test.mts src/shared/chatGate.test.mts src/shared/voiceSession.test.mts src/shared/characterPresence.test.mts src/shared/desktopMovement.test.mts src/shared/wander.test.mts src/shared/neonTrail.test.mts src/shared/productionMovement.test.mts src/shared/userPreferences.test.mts src/shared/windowsLoginStartup.test.mts src/shared/packagedRelease.test.mts src/renderer/speechCapture.test.mts src/renderer/chromiumTts.test.mts scripts/local-speech.test.mjs scripts/tts-pilot.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke
